sourceIssueHolds.reason: English gloss is reused for present 해요 and past 했어요 and can misidentify the embedded friend as reporter. 1961/2159 explanations distinguish reporting tense; shared prompts/options must remain temporally underspecified. Source-key split/canonical review needed.
Weather is content of the report, not speaker. Rendered as reported good weather.
Rain is content of report, not speaker. Rendered as reported rainfall.
Canonical 글씨가 써져요 contains no 잘/well; no unsupported quality claim added.
Canonical 동생에게 옷을 입혀요 includes younger sibling recipient. Preserve unspecified sibling gender and causative dressing.
Canonical 동생을 울게 했어요 includes younger sibling causee, gender unknown; not replaced with generic gendered child.
Canonical 메모를 남겨 드릴까요 offers to LEAVE a message, not receive/take one; romanization punctuation also differs at 2419 and remains exact.
Canonical sentence has no 빠르게/rapidly; translated development without unsupported speed.
Canonical 송편을 빚어요 itself does not state Chuseok; translation does not add an occasion.
Canonical 음식을 나눠 먹어요 does not specify neighbors; translation keeps sharing and eating food.
Compressed English gloss omits proposition: canonical says the essence/main thing is important. Full native proposition retained.
Canonical explanation 2635 names Assistant Manager Kim. Full explanation retains Kim without gender assumptions; shared generic gloss elsewhere stays generic.
Korean answer option is awkward as standalone target; kept byte-for-byte. Canonical author/teacher should confirm pedagogical acceptability; no silent source repair.

authoringContext.policy: Existing sources only; no new fictional entity settings authored. Unknown genders/referents/counts remain unknown.
authoringContext.genderEvidence: No gender inferred from names Kim/Minsu/Mina or professions. Explicit grandmother/mother/father words retain lexical meaning; sibling gender remains unknown.
authoringContext.genericReferents: person and Naija impersonal dem represent unspecified source referents, not invented named entities or established plural groups.
authoringContext.grammaticalGender: not_applicable for these Naija person references
authoringContext.courseStages: K1..K10 are course stages; no claim of official proficiency grades.
authoringContext.register: Honorific/formal/humble information retained where present in source meaning; native register validation pending.
